payload.author: claude
payload.body: PARTIAL — web done, native REVERTED. The Swift/Kotlin half (committed in 6e65f27) made the EXISTING subscribe methods block until a Snapshot arrives, which deadlocked the Swift test suite (testSubscribeSendsSubscribeFrame held the SwiftPM lock for ~2h). Reverted the native sockets in 1252d3d — Swift suite is green again (174 tests, 7s; testSubscribeSendsSubscribeFrame 11ms). The WEB half stays: packages/core added NEW subscribeObject/subscribeStream/subscribeProjection methods (additive, alongside the unchanged objects()/stream() accessors), covered by passing vitest (121 core tests). Native follow-up filed as FR-291: do it ADDITIVELY (new awaitable methods, leave existing subscribe semantics intact) + update the test harness to deliver the correlating Snapshot.
